name: Deploy Contract (Testnet)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      network:
        description: "Network to deploy to"
        required: true
        default: "testnet"
        type: choice
        options:
          - testnet
          - mainnet

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy Registry Contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: wasm32v1-none

      - name: Cache Rust artifacts
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-deploy-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}

      - name: Build WASM
        run: cargo build --manifest-path contracts/registry/Cargo.toml --target wasm32v1-none --release

      - name: Install Stellar CLI
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/stellar/stellar-cli/releases/latest/download/stellar-cli-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv stellar /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Configure Stellar identity
        run: |
          echo "${{ secrets.DEPLOYER_SECRET_KEY }}" | stellar keys add deployer --secret-key
        env:
          STELLAR_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOYER_SECRET_KEY }}

      - name: Upload WASM
        id: upload
        run: |
          WASM_HASH=$(stellar contract upload \
            --network ${{ inputs.network }} \
            --source deployer \
            --wasm target/wasm32v1-none/release/soroban_verify_registry.wasm)
          echo "wasm_hash=$WASM_HASH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Deploy contract
        id: deploy
        run: |
          CONTRACT_ID=$(stellar contract deploy \
            --network ${{ inputs.network }} \
            --source deployer \
            --wasm-hash ${{ steps.upload.outputs.wasm_hash }})
          echo "contract_id=$CONTRACT_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Initialize contract
        run: |
          stellar contract invoke \
            --network ${{ inputs.network }} \
            --source deployer \
            --id ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.contract_id }} \
            -- initialize \
            --admin $(stellar keys address deployer)

      - name: Print deployment info
        run: |
          echo "✅ Registry contract deployed!"
          echo "Network:     ${{ inputs.network }}"
          echo "WASM hash:   ${{ steps.upload.outputs.wasm_hash }}"
          echo "Contract ID: ${{ steps.deploy.outputs.contract_id }}"
